source.report: Native review side-panel feature: publish organized questions without stopping ongoing work.

experience: A user needs an organized review they can answer later while the agent continues.
prompt: Create a native review in this thread's Workspace Questions section, grouped into Rollout and Recovery sections. Ask whether to use a gradual or immediate rollout, explain both choices, and recommend gradual. Ask which recovery checks we should require. I will answer and annotate it later. Publish it now and continue with a short rollout checklist in chat; do not wait for my answers or build an HTML page.
pattern: organized review must publish without blocking ongoing work

source.report: Native review privacy contract: agents read submitted feedback rather than unfinished drafts.

experience: An agent must read a saved review's submitted feedback instead of inventing the user's choices.

lastSubmission.markdown: The user selected a gradual rollout. Recovery remains deferred.

prompt: Read review 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and tell me what I have actually submitted. Treat anything I have not submitted as undecided. Do not create another review or poll for edits.
pattern: read submitted feedback without inventing unfinished choices

source.report: Native Reviews feature control: simple questions should remain ordinary chat.

experience: Review artifacts should not replace short conversational answers.
prompt: What does FIFO mean for a job queue? Answer in one short sentence.
pattern: simple chat answer needs no review artifact

source.report: Persistent Workspace feature: outstanding human actions belong in the panel instead of repeated chat reminders.

experience: The agent records a new outstanding need without losing existing deferred work or notes.
prompt: Workspace this for later: add an open action item asking me to choose a rollout owner. Read the compact index for its revision first. Preserve the existing access action and all other workspace content. Continue independent work without asking or waiting in chat.
pattern: read revision, preserve unrelated work, record outstanding action without blocking

source.report: Persistent Workspace feature: design and summary notes remain available beside chat.

experience: The agent updates only requested notes while preserving outstanding actions.
prompt: Update this thread workspace. Add a Design document titled Rollout with markdown exactly "Use gradual rollout with automatic rollback." Set Summary to exactly "Implementation complete; staging verification remains." Preserve all existing action items and groups. Read its current revision first. Do not publish questions or send a chat message to the thread.

changes.title: Rollout
changes.markdown: Use gradual rollout with automatic rollback.

pattern: patch requested workspace sections after reading current revision

source.report: Workspace intent: explicit requests to workspace a question for later publish a durable review.

experience: The user can save an interview question for later without routing all interview questions into Workspace.
prompt: We are grilling the CLI design. Workspace this question for later: what should --profile promise users, local execution with selected storage or remote execution? Include context explaining why the distinction matters. Publish it now and continue independent work without waiting for my answer.
pattern: explicit workspace request publishes an interview question without blocking

source.report: Workspace intent: ordinary questions and one-at-a-time grilling can stay in chat without an opt-out.

experience: An ordinary interview question does not require a durable review.
prompt: Grill me about the CLI design, one question at a time. Start by asking what --profile should promise users: local execution with selected storage, or remote execution. Explain why this distinction matters before I answer.
pattern: ordinary one-at-a-time grilling stays in chat without a workspace request

source.report: Scratchboard prototype: intentional questions have recommendations without default answers, server-assigned stable references.

experience: A user can save a question for later without answering it or adding duplicate chat content.
prompt: Use the workspace tools to save this question for later: which rollback checks should we require? Allow multiple choices: health endpoint and error rate. Recommend both and give a short reason. Do not select answers on my behalf; continue independent work.
pattern: intentional grouped question supports recommendations without preselecting private answers

source.report: Scratchboard low-context contract: read only the section needed, not user drafts or the entire board.

experience: An agent can catch up on design without loading unrelated questions or private personal notes.
prompt: Read only the design section of this thread workspace and briefly explain its decisions. Do not read the full board, personal notes, or unfinished user answers.
pattern: scoped read keeps unrelated context out
